status: prospective for all production metric profiles; frozen after training and before v3 production metrics

primary_profile.scope: all stored primary checkpoints for temporal geometry, margins, NTK, and probes; persistent homology only at initialization and final matched-risk state

ablation_profile.scope: initial and final matched-risk endpoints; persistent homology is supporting and uses five deterministic subsamples

rationale: Temporal ordering is a primary-study question. Recomputing PH at every optimization checkpoint and every ablation does not create independent replicates. Endpoint PH supports, but does not define, the geometric and fiber-survival claims.
immutability: Any further change requires a new versioned plan.
